name: Zuzanna Szalaty
tagline: Building maintainable software that solves real business problems.

featured.text: A scanner-first Barcode app for Odoo: the scanner core, stock operations, the device camera, GS1 labels, purchases, scrap, quality checks and inventory counts.
Migrated the Business Requirement suite to Odoo 18 and added RICE prioritisation: reach, impact, confidence and effort.
bc3_importer: imports construction budgets from BC3 files, the standard exchange format in Spain.
